method: isolated original-code execution, Unicorn 2.1.4, no stubs

cases.name: codec-below-base-wrap
cases.note: enc=FFFFFFF8 dec=22FFFFFF8

cases.name: ins-empty-root
cases.note: empty tree: root at ctx+0x50 stored as a full qword; links enc(0)=0

cases.name: ins-left-signed
cases.note: key -5 under key 100 must go LEFT (signed jle); unsigned goes right

cases.name: ins-right
cases.note: key 200 under key 100 goes right

cases.name: ins-equal-right
cases.note: key 100 equal to A: jle still takes the right arm, then left of C(200)

cases.name: ins-clears-stale-links
cases.note: 0036B410 rewrites all three links with enc(0) before the walk

cases.name: ins-null-node
cases.note: null node returns before touching the tree

cases.name: ins-null-tree-faults
cases.note: ctx=0 insert reads [0x50] for the root -> original fault

cases.name: ins-nonzero-base-faults
cases.note: G=0x30000000: original insert writes A links enc(0)=D0000000, which decode to 0x1_0000_0000, not null - the second insert descends and faults reading its key. The tree cannot express an empty child under any nonzero base.

cases.name: ins-high-node-silent-alias
cases.note: G=0: a node above 4GiB links as its low dword 0x8000 - silent truncation, no fault at insert time

cases.name: ins-walk-follows-alias
cases.note: walk decodes A.left=0x8000 to the planted wrong node (key 1000) and inserts key 60 beneath it: silent misdirection, still no fault

cases.name: rem-root-empty
cases.note: removing a lone root writes 0 to ctx+0x50

cases.name: rem-root-left-only
cases.note: root with only a left child: left promoted to root

cases.name: rem-root-right-only
cases.note: root with only a right child: right promoted to root

cases.name: rem-root-both-reinserts-left
cases.note: executes the rebalance the contract left underived: root removal promotes right, then re-inserts the whole left subtree via 0036B4E0

cases.name: rem-leaf-stale-parent
cases.note: executed check of the carried claim: the standalone remove leaves the removed node's own links stale (parent still points at A)

cases.name: rem-nonroot-left-only
cases.note: non-root without right child: 0036B490 splices the left subtree into the parent slot that held the node

cases.name: rem-nonroot-both-promotes-right
cases.note: non-root with both children: right promoted into the parent slot, left reinserted under it; removed node keeps its stale links

cases.name: rem-null-node
cases.note: null node returns immediately

cases.name: rem-null-tree-nonroot-ok
cases.note: ctx is only the root holder: non-root removal never dereferences it

cases.name: rem-null-tree-root-faults
cases.note: removing a root with ctx=0 faults writing the new root to [0x50]

cases.name: tag-add-valid
cases.note: handle slot|1, gen match, not member: inserts into the tree selected by obj+3, sets +0x15 bit 1, clears +0x3E

cases.name: tag-add-already-member
cases.note: membership bit already set: no call, no writes (idempotent add)

cases.name: tag-add-gen-mismatch
cases.note: word[slot+6] != word[obj+0x1C]: refused before the membership test

cases.name: tag-add-null-handle
cases.note: handle gate refuses before any write

cases.name: tag-add-untagged
cases.note: handle gate refuses before any write

cases.name: tag-add-small-handle
cases.note: handle gate refuses before any write

cases.name: tag-add-null-obj-faults
cases.note: UNLIKE remove, add has no null-object check: slot+8=0 faults reading the generation at [0x1C]

cases.name: tag-add-index-overflow-faults
cases.note: obj+3 >= 0xF -> ctx=0 -> insert reads [0x50]; the table boundary is observed as an original fault

cases.name: tag-remove-valid
cases.note: member remove: tree removal runs, +0x15 bit 1 cleared, returns obj+0x40

cases.name: tag-remove-not-member
cases.note: NOT a member: skips the helper and the bit clear, still returns obj+0x40

cases.name: tag-remove-gen-mismatch
cases.note: generation mismatch: returns 0, object untouched

cases.name: tag-remove-null-obj
cases.note: remove DOES check slot+8 for null - the asymmetry with add

cases.name: wrap-add-null
cases.note: 003AB940(0): returns without calling the tagged add

cases.name: wrap-add-untagged
cases.note: h&3==0: returns without the tagged add

cases.name: wrap-add-tagged
cases.note: h&3!=0 tail-jumps into 0036D170

cases.name: wrap-remove-null
cases.note: 003AB880(0): returns 0

cases.name: wrap-remove-untagged-identity
cases.note: h&3==0: returns the input handle unchanged, no call

cases.name: wrap-remove-tag2-tagged
cases.note: h=slot|2 (h&3==2, h&1==0): still dispatched as tagged

cases.name: wrap-remove-tagged
cases.note: h&3!=0 tail-jumps into 0036A000

mutants.name: mut-unsigned-order
mutants.note: jle->jbe at 0036B50D: unsigned compare sends key -5 RIGHT

mutants.name: mut-equal-left
mutants.note: jle->jl at 0036B50D: equal key now goes LEFT

mutants.name: mut-member-mask4
mutants.note: test byte [rbx+0x15] mask 2->4: a member inserts a second time

mutants.name: mut-remove-root-flip
mutants.note: jne->je at 0036C7DD: non-root removal takes the root path and clears the tree root

mutants.name: mut-wrapper-mask1
mutants.note: test dl,3 -> test dl,1: handle slot|2 wrongly reads untagged
